content: Resilient scraper pipelines separate concerns into layers: orchestration/queue (Redis+BullMQ or SQS) for scheduling/retries/dedup, proxy management (rotating residential/ISP proxies with per-domain rate limiting), fetching (Playwright with stealth patches for JS-heavy/anti-bot sites), parsing (decoupled from fetching so schema changes don't require re-scraping), and storage+observability. Exponential backoff with jitter for retries; per-domain token-bucket rate limiting (start ~1 req/2-3s for protected sites). Common failure mode: monolithic scraper with no queue/retry/backoff layer collapses when target site changes or blocks IPs.
